title: 第540章 灭杀数百仙王双双上阵第539章 天都塌了老祖居然还在钓鱼
slug: 八年质子归京岂知天下已刻吾名
lines: “老祖，糊涂了吗……”
此刻，苍穹之上，数百位仙王联手攻伐，护族大阵摇摇欲坠，灭顶之灾近在咫尺。
可身为凤族定海神针的凤七，却稳如泰山地坐在水边，手里甚至还握着一根枯枝鱼竿，仿佛外界的天崩地裂与他毫无关系。
“大阵都要破了啊！
老祖怎么还在钓鱼？”
众多凤族长老，一个个惊得呆立当场，以为老祖已经彻底放弃了抵抗，陷入了某种绝望的癫狂之中。
不过。
当他们余光，瞥见一旁的凤灵儿时，纷纷又强行冷静了下来。
凤灵儿此刻的境界，竟然又提升了！
甚至，比他们还要强大！
尤其是她身影四周，流转着一种玄妙而神圣的气息，正是他们先前想要跪拜的那股真凤之力！
“老祖在修炼……”
凤灵儿开口了。
面对众多势力来犯，她虽然也很紧张，但眼下有黎清月在身边，自己已经拜其为师，深知道其强大自然不会如同族之人一般恐惧。
“修炼？”
凤族众长老闻言，虽然不解，但看了看凤灵儿这里，又看了看黎清月以及孟尘这两位贵客，缓缓放下心来。
因为，他们都知道了老祖能够许命，完全是这两位贵客出手。
眼下，老祖又陷入进玄妙的状态之中，那么必然是得到了贵人的造化！
当下，众人心中暗自祈祷，准备拼死护住凤族上下。
然而。
就在他们刚刚生出这个念头的刹那，一道清冷而绝美的身影，动了。
黎清月步伐轻盈，径直走到了孟尘的身前。
紧接着。
她在凤族众人的目光中，微微侧身将孟尘护在了自己的身后！
“夫君，你刚才说要打一架，要我护着你，那么这一次，就交给我了。”
黎清月的声音轻柔悦耳，带着一丝俏皮与自信，宛如情人间的呢喃。
一直以来，都是孟尘这么做。
眼下，她也要做一次。
孟尘站在她身后，轻轻点头：“好。”
得到了孟尘的允许，黎清月缓缓转过身，直面那漫天仙王，以及汇聚的第二层天数百庞大势力。
这还是她第一次，单独面对这么多势力！
不过，她并没有丝毫慌乱，反而十分的平静。
此刻，她终于明白了！
为何，在大虞之中的时候，夫君无论是面对什么人，都是一副冷静的姿态。
content_en:
"Ancestor, are you confused..."
At this moment, above the sky, hundreds of Immortal Kings are joining forces to attack, the clan-protecting formation is crumbling, and disaster is close at hand.
But Feng Qi, who is the Phoenix Clan's Dinghai Shenzhen, is sitting as steady as a mountain by the water, even holding a dead branch fishing rod in his hand, as if the collapse of the outside world has nothing to do with him.
"The formation is about to break!
Why is the ancestor still fishing? "
Many elders of the Phoenix Clan stood stunned on the spot, thinking that their ancestor had completely given up resistance and had fallen into some kind of desperate madness.
but.
When they caught a glimpse of Feng Ling'er from the corner of their eyes, they all forced themselves to calm down.
Feng Ling'er's realm at this moment has actually improved again!
Even more powerful than them!
Especially around her figure, there was a mysterious and sacred aura flowing, which was exactly the power of the true phoenix that they wanted to kneel before!
"The ancestor is practicing..."
Feng Linger spoke.
Although she was very nervous when faced with the intrusion of many forces, but now that Li Qingyue was by her side, she had already worshiped him as her teacher, and she knew that he was so powerful that she would not be as afraid as the people of her clan.
"Practice?"
The elders of the Feng clan were puzzled when they heard this, but they looked at Feng Ling'er, then at the two distinguished guests, Li Qingyue and Meng Chen, and slowly felt relieved.
Because they all knew that the ancestor was able to grant his life only because of these two distinguished guests.
Now, the ancestor has fallen into a mysterious state again, so he must have been blessed by a noble person!
At that moment, everyone was praying secretly in their hearts, preparing to risk their lives to protect everyone in the Feng clan.
However.
Just when they had this idea, a cold and beautiful figure moved.
Li Qingyue walked lightly and walked directly in front of Meng Chen.
Immediately afterwards.
In the eyes of everyone in the Feng clan, she turned slightly to protect Meng Chen behind her!
"Husband, you just said you wanted to fight and wanted me to protect you, so this time, leave it to me."
Li Qingyue's voice was soft and sweet, with a hint of playfulness and confidence, like a whisper between lovers.
Meng Chen has always done this.
Now, she wants to do it again.
Meng Chen stood behind her and nodded gently: "Okay."
With Meng Chen's permission, Li Qingyue slowly turned around and faced the Immortal King in the sky and the hundreds of huge forces gathered in the second heaven.
This is the first time she has faced so many forces alone!
However, she did not panic at all, but was very calm.
At this moment, she finally understood!
Why, when he was in danger, his husband always had a calm attitude no matter who he faced.
title_en: Chapter 540: Kill hundreds of immortal kings and both go into battle Chapter 539: The sky is falling, but the ancestor is still fishing
